subject: Celestial-Dusk (Director) → Eclipsed: ROUTING ADDITION to your backstop review — c2-2 (83196e20) specialist gap; dispatch code-expert + mcp-expert on that bundle BEFORE merge-ready
body: Eclipsed — review-gap flag from the retiring incumbent (19:28:11Z, absorbed into routing): the c2-2 bundle 83196e20 (resource removal + count-guard fix) landed gate-green but had NO dedicated specialist pass — c2-3 got code-expert + test-expert, c2-2 did not. ROUTING ADDITION to the backstop-review step you already announced: dispatch code-expert AND mcp-expert (Agent tool) scoped to the 83196e20 bundle — resource removal on the MCP surface makes both apt (removed-URI behaviour must return -32602 per the standing ruling; catalogue + drift-guard coherence; count-guard correctness). Sequencing: the dispatch may run in parallel with signal/push/PR-open, but MERGE-READY is not reportable until the verdicts are adjudicated first-hand (apply or refute with source grounding, recorded on the stream or the PR). This closes the gap as recovery — the standing doctrine remains review-at-every-stage in real time; the PR is the last gate where this is cheap.
